name: 老班长·湘里 Taste of Hunan Haymarket
reviews: We visited this newly opened brand and we were very happy with their warm reception, attentive service and quick serving of our orders. The smelly bean curb is good, the fried egg with vinegar is good. The cabbage yummy too
好吃 有锅气！四个人点了六道菜，全都光盘了👍

omg the clay pot chicken was so so so delicious!!! i personally have a tiny appetite and i don’t really eat spicy food, but omg it was so addicting to eat, and i ate the whole clay pot almost all by myself! The boss lady is also super super friendly and nice, she gave us a free duck neck entree (it was spicy but super yummy) AND 杨梅汤 （chinese bayberry drink, super super good, i drank it in one gulp, seriously). I feel like from the google maps, it’s hard to find this place, but please, DO TRY TO LOOK FOR IT! so so worth it and a really amazing place for hunan food! if i could give a million stars, I WOULD

I literally wish I could rate this place 0 out of 5 - place is a mess and kitchen hygiene is so bad with chefs wearing no hat. While I was waiting, I heard some customers complaining about hair in their food and not sure if it’s the owner, lady just said it’s customers own hair - shocking. Anyways coming down to my own experience, been told there - it’s only 15 mins away and turns out to be the order was never processed. Restaurant also refused to refund so we had to go through rounds of argument and waited for another 30 mins. What a waste of time! Digusting place.
